hooks.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && BACKEND_PORT=$(grep -oP 'http://localhost:\K\d+' frontend/vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null || echo 8000) && FRONTEND_PORT=$(grep -oP 'port:\s*\K\d+' frontend/vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null || echo 5173) && lsof -ti:$BACKEND_PORT | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:$FRONTEND_PORT | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; true
